meaning: empty talk, idle talk, liar, lie

elsewhere.note: Should your boastings make men hold their peace? When you mock, will no man make you ashamed?
We have heard of the pride of Moab, that he is very proud; even of his arrogance, his pride, and his wrath. His boastings are nothing.
I know his wrath,” says Yahweh, “that it is nothing; his boastings have done nothing.
The sword will fall on their cities, and will destroy the bars of their gates, and will put an end to their plans.
